• Contact centres that cancelled due to provider switching within 2 weeks of cancellation to understand specific gaps in service (timing, program variety, pricing) and offer solutions before they finalise alternative arrangements.

• Develop a simple "in-house transition" proposal template that addresses cost savings and customisation concerns, positioning your service as complementary rather than competitive.
